results.title: CHAMPAIGNPark_District
results.description: This polygon data layer contains the boundaries of park districts in Champaign County according to the taxing codes for each parcel in the county. Road right-of-way and other areas where no tax parcel polygon is present were included to make the polygon continuous. The County Clerk's Office maintains taxing records listing all the entities that each property in the county pays taxes into and this data layer maps one of those taxing entities.
results.snippet: This data layer is intended to convey which parcels are within the park districts according to the taxing code for each parcel in Champaign County as of the end of the revenue year.  A related features class, the SDE OpenSpaces (Parks) feature class, was drawn based on land usage, not ownership and taxing codes as this data layer was created.

results.title: URBANASchool_District
results.description: This polygon data layer contains the boundaries of Champaign County School taxing districts in Champaign County according to the taxing codes for each parcel in the county. Road right-of-way and other areas where no tax parcel polygon is present were included to make the polygon continuous. The County Clerk's Office maintains taxing records listing all the entities that each property in the county pays taxes into and this data layer maps one of those taxing entities.
results.snippet:
This data layer is intended to convey which parcels are within the School taxing districts according to the taxing code for each parcel in Champaign County at the end of the revenue year.  Having this data layer will be valuable as a visual reference showing if the parcels pay taxes into this taxing district or not at this time.  This layer is updated as tax codes change throughout the year.

results.name: school_districts
results.title: Champaign County Ohio School Districts
results.description: This shapefile contains 8 school districts found within the boundaries of Champaign County Ohio. Those schools are: Graham Local School District, Mechanicsburg Exempted Village School District, Miami East Local School District, Northeastern Local School District, Northwestern School District, Triad Local School District, Urbana City School District, West Liberty-Salem Local School District. Only Graham Local Schools and Urbana Local City Schools are contained completely within the boundaries of Champaign County. The districts are defined by school district codes found within local land parcel data.
results.snippet: This feature class/shapefile captures public school district boundaries within the political boundries of Champaign County Ohio.
